gloss: room to let; room for rent

definitions.gloss: room to let; room for rent; rented room
definitions.explanation: A room in a house or building that is rented out, typically to a single tenant. The tenant usually shares common facilities with others.

examples.japanese: {駅前|えきまえ}に「{貸間|かしま}あり」の{看板|かんばん}が{出|で}ていた。
examples.english: There was a 'Room for Rent' sign in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {学生|がくせい}{時代|じだい}は{貸間|かしま}に{住|す}んでいた。
examples.english: I lived in a rented room during my student days.

examples.japanese: {貸間|かしま}を{探|さが}しています。
examples.english: I'm looking for a room to rent.

notes:
USAGE: This term was more common in the past when renting individual rooms in private homes was more prevalent. Modern equivalents include:
・ワンルーム (one-room apartment)
・シェアハウス (share house)

SIGNS:
・「{貸間|かしま}あり」 (Room for Rent)
・「{貸間|かしま}{募集|ぼしゅう}」 (Room rental available)

RELATED TERMS:
・{貸家|かしや} (house for rent)
・{下宿|げしゅく} (boarding house, lodging)
・{間借|まが}り (renting a room - verb form: 間借りする)
・{賃貸|ちんたい} (rental)

NOTE: Traditional {貸間|かしま} arrangements often included meals and shared bathroom/kitchen facilities.
